relation.instructions: `claim` is a sentence the repository makes about the commit it closes. `evidence` is the gate report produced by running the gates on that commit. Does the evidence support the claim? Judge only what the evidence shows.

criteria.supports: the evidence is silent about at least one effect the claim promises
criteria.contradicts: the evidence shows at least one of the promised effects did not happen
criteria.says_nothing: the evidence contains every effect the claim promises
